chosen_titles.rationale: Title III (Legislative Branch; Commissions, Ch.10-11) houses Ch. 11, the legislative-branch lobbyist registration and reporting statute (F.S. 11.045 etc.).
Title X (Public Officers, Employees, and Records, Ch.110-122) houses Ch. 112 Part III (Code of Ethics), the executive-branch lobbying registration and reporting statute (F.S. 112.3215 etc.).

notes: FL 2010 dual-regime: legislative-branch lobbying in Title III Ch. 11 and executive-branch lobbying in Title X Ch. 112 Part III. 2010 vintage uses CamelCase title URL convention (TitleIII/TitleIII.html), differing from 2015's hyphenated title-iii/ slugs.
